name: Admin Proposal Resend
description: Resend an already-sent proposal from the actions modal. An editor preloads the retained personalized message, lets the admin change it, and disables resend while it is blank. 'Guardar y re-enviar' persists the edited email_intro and POSTs /proposals/:id/resend/; the delivery keeps expires_at, resets sent_at and reminder timers, and returns email_delivery. Prior email snapshots remain unchanged.
